verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should (tagline, then headline, then CTA) and keeps the headline as the focal point. Its flaws are a tiny underline stranded in the bottom-right corner, apart from 'Shop the deal', a small CTA, and a tagline that is hard to read at this size. B inverts the hierarchy: 'Shop the deal' is huge and wraps awkwardly onto two lines, jammed against the right edge, while the headline 'Buy 1 piece Get 1 free' shrinks to a small, hard-to-read cluster. B also places the headline above its own tagline and leaves the left half of the canvas empty.
